messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Government, political systems and organisations in German Democratic Republic (1949-1990) during the 1990s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: dataset GDR East Germany 1990 Volkskammer election results data
GESIS DDR 1990 survey political institutions dataset
Bundesarchiv DDR government party organisations archival database dataset
action.query: dataset GDR East Germany 1990 Volkskammer election results data

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"DDR Attitudes on Current Questions of Domestic Policy (1990) – GDR","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1967","justification":"Highly relevant GESIS survey dataset examining political attitudes in the German Democratic Republic during 1990. Includes satisfaction with democracy, political party preferences, voting behavior, attitudes toward the Socialist Unity Party (SED) and Party of Democratic Socialism (PDS), political institutions, reunification, and perceptions of democratic development. Particularly valuable for studying political transformation during the GDR's final year."},{"title":"International Social Survey Programme: Role of Government II – ISSP 1990","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1950","justification":"International survey dataset containing a separate East German sample of 1,028 respondents interviewed in 1990. Examines attitudes toward government responsibilities, state intervention, public policy, and political institutions. Useful for comparing perceptions of government in East Germany with those in West Germany and other countries during the transition from socialism."},{"title":"German Democratic Republic: Parliamentary Elections – Volkskammer 1990","url_or_doi":"https://data.ipu.org/election-summary/HTML/2121bis_90.htm","justification":"Historical parliamentary election data published by the Inter-Parliamentary Union documenting the GDR's first free parliamentary elections on March 18, 1990. Includes information on political parties, electoral competition, parliamentary representation, and election outcomes. Particularly relevant for analyzing the transformation of the East German political system and the emergence of multiparty democracy."},{"title":"Leben in der DDR 1990 (Life in the GDR 1990)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA6873?lang=de","justification":"GESIS research dataset documenting life in the German Democratic Republic in 1990. Provides contemporary survey evidence from the final year of the GDR. Useful for investigating social conditions and public experiences during the transition from the socialist political system to German reunification. The dataset provides historical context for research into political and institutional changes."},{"title":"Political Attitudes, Political Participation and Voting Behavior in Reunified Germany 1994 (ZA3065)","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA3065?lang=en","justification":"Survey dataset collected around the 1994 German federal election, examining political attitudes, political participation, and electoral behavior after reunification. Relevant for studying the political integration of former GDR citizens, the development of party preferences, and democratic participation in eastern Germany during the 1990s. Particularly useful for investigating the political legacy of the former East German system."},{"title":"Bundesarchiv – Digitized Collections of the German Democratic Republic (1945–1990)","url_or_doi":"https://www.bundesarchiv.de/im-archiv-recherchieren/archivgut-recherchieren/digitalisierte-bestaende/","justification":"Official German Federal Archives portal providing access to digitized historical collections concerning the GDR. Relevant collections include records of the Volkskammer's tenth legislative period in 1990, the Central Round Table, and political organizations. These structured archival collections provide primary evidence about government institutions, parliamentary activities, and political decision-making during the final phase of the GDR. Primarily an archival resource rather than a conventional statistical dataset."},{"title":"Bundesarchiv – Foundation Archives of the Parties and Mass Organizations of the GDR (SAPMO)","url_or_doi":"https://www.bundesarchiv.de/das-bundesarchiv/organisation/abteilungen/ddr-sapmo/","justification":"Official archival collection documenting political parties and mass organizations in East Germany. Includes records of the Socialist Unity Party, its Politburo and Central Committee, trade unions, the Free German Youth, and other political and social organizations. Covers the period from the establishment of the GDR through 1990. Valuable for reconstructing political organization, institutional structures, party membership, and government-party relationships. The material consists primarily of archival records rather than ready-to-analyze datasets."},{"title":"Bundesarchiv – Records of German Reunification","url_or_doi":"https://wiedervereinigung.bundesarchiv.de/akten-zur-wiedervereinigung.html","justification":"Historical archival resource containing government records documenting the political and administrative processes leading to German reunification in 1990. Includes materials relating to the GDR Council of Ministers, government ministries, and institutional decision-making. Useful for researching the dissolution of East German political institutions, government restructuring, and the transition to the unified German state."},{"title":"Bundesarchiv – Machine-Readable Data from the Stasi Records Archive","url_or_doi":"https://www.bundesarchiv.de/stasi-unterlagen-archiv/bestandsuebersichten/bestaende-und-teilbestaende-des-stasi-unterlagen-archivs/36-maschinenlesbare-daten-1/","justification":"Official archival inventory of machine-readable data originating from the GDR Ministry for State Security (Stasi). Relevant for investigating the administrative information systems and organizational practices of one of East Germany's most important state institutions. Provides information about historical databases used by the GDR security apparatus. Availability of individual datasets may be restricted, and the resource should not be treated as an unrestricted public data download."},{"title":"Parties, Organizations and Movements during the Peaceful Revolution (Parteien, Organisationen, Bewegungen in der Wendezeit)","url_or_doi":"https://www.deutsche-digitale-bibliothek.de/item/6WPOUSYKBAM6AOF26F2H2JBSVZ3PVITR","justification":"Archival collection documenting political parties, organizations, and civic movements active during the political transformation of East Germany around 1989–1990. Relevant for studying opposition movements, the emergence of new political organizations, and changes in the GDR's party system. Particularly useful for investigating the institutional transition from one-party socialist rule to political pluralism. This is an archival collection rather than a standardized quantitative dataset."}]}
